scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finguide/api" "npm run dev -w @finguide/web"
scripts.build: node api.js && npm run build -w @finguide/contracts && npm run build -w @finguide/api && npm run build -w @finguide/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @finguide/api && npm run test -w @finguide/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @finguide/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @finguide/api && npm run typecheck -w @finguide/web
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
